title: EXIT_RECOMMENDATION message (MTap to MBin, v1, draft)
description: MTap's advice to close all or part of a held position, or the withdrawal of that advice. Level-triggered: re-sent with a new revision while active. Stream mtap:evt:EXIT_RECOMMENDATION, durable. See mtap-mbin-protocol.md section 8.2.

exit_id.description: Stable for one exit episode on one position. A later, unrelated exit on the same position gets a new exit_id.

revision.description: Increments on every publish of this exit_id, refreshes included, so each publish has a fresh _key. MBin keeps the highest revision and ignores lower ones.

state.description: cleared withdraws the advice; MBin removes the highlight.

ttl_ms.description: Validity from data_ts_utc, same defaults and clamps as RECOMMENDATION. An active exit that is not refreshed lapses, so an active exit carries at least 60000 (two 30 s refreshes).

position_ref.description: Which position. position_key from POSITIONS_SNAPSHOT is preferred; account_alias plus symbol is the fallback.

reason_text.description: Shown on the highlight, e.g. 'probability dropped to 0.41'.

suggested_qty.description: Shares to sell. Null or absent: the whole position. MBin caps it at the quantity held.

probability.description: The forecast that triggered exit:prob-drop, if any.

inputs.description: Free-form, stored for audit. Keep it under 4 KB.

account_alias.description: Account by role (D17). Account numbers and accountIdKey never cross the boundary.
